title: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure not accepted
entities.description: Procedure executed when the network rejects a PDN disconnection request from the UE. The MME sends a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message and the UE handles the rejection according to the received ESM cause.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request disconnection of a PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the MME to reject a PDN disconnection request from the UE.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity used to identify the transaction.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for ESM procedure rejection. Contains values like #35, #43, #49, #95-111.

entities.name: T3492
entities.description: Timer associated with the PDN disconnection procedure.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by the UE after receiving PDN DISCONNECT REJECT.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported
entities.description: Condition where both UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without any PDN connection.

entities.name: Local EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: UE locally deactivates EPS bearer contexts without peer-to-peer signaling.

relations.description: Procedure starts with receipt of PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
MME sends PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message when request is not accepted.
PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message contains PTI IE.
PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message contains ESM cause IE.
UE stops timer T3492 upon receipt of PDN DISCONNECT REJECT.
UE enters PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state after receiving PDN DISCONNECT REJECT.
ESM cause #49 applicability is guarded by EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support condition.
ESM cause value determines whether UE performs local EPS bearer context deactivation.
